CheckpointRequest.description: Checkpoint index must match the path and completed prefix; referenced artifacts must already be durable and verified. Existing 256 KiB checkpoint JSON limit remains in force.

ModelReceipt.description: Submission receipt only. It never returns held-out scores.

ResourceLimits.description: All limits are enforced server-side against workspace policy; zero disallows use of a resource. CPU/wall must be positive for an executable run. Bounds and price policy require review before contract freeze.

RunView.description: Public run state. No hidden world configuration, provider credential or active evaluation scores. Counters must agree with authoritative reservations.

runBearer.description: Short-lived run/attempt/epoch-scoped token. Cannot read hidden worlds, provider secrets or evaluator results.

workspaceBearer.description: Verified user/service identity, with current workspace authorization.

info.description: Planning contract, not an implemented endpoint or complete platform API. First subset: create/read/cancel runs, public observations, checkpoints, model receipts and event resume. Workspace identity/management, world/package upload, provider calls, exports, audit, SSO and SCIM require separate reviewed contracts in SP-01 and their work packages.
